tactic 'rfl' failed, the left-hand side
  match xs, h_precond with
  | [], h_precond => 0
  | head :: tail, h_precond =>
    List.brecOn (motive := fun ys => Nat → Nat) xs
      (fun ys f idx =>
        (match (motive := (ys : List Int) → List.below (motive := fun ys => Nat → Nat) ys → Nat) ys with
          | [] => fun x => idx
          | y :: ys' => fun x =>
            let isCurrent := y;
            let currentIndex := idx;
            let targetValue := target;
            let condition := targetValue ≤ isCurrent;
            if condition then currentIndex
            else
              let incrementedIndex := currentIndex + 1;
              let rest := ys';
              x.1 incrementedIndex)
          f)
      0
